description: This file defines the interface and classes for a UDP socket implementation using Starboard platform APIs, including socket operations, asynchronous I/O, multicast, and socket configuration.

classes.name: SendResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a UDP send operation, including return value, write count, and buffers.

classes.name: UDPSocketStarboardSender
classes.description: A reference-counted class responsible for sending UDP buffers via Starboard sockets.

classes.name: UDPSocketStarboard
classes.description: A class implementing UDP socket operations using Starboard platform APIs, supporting asynchronous I/O, multicast, and socket configuration.

methods.name: SendBuffers
methods.description: Sends multiple datagram buffers to a specified socket and address.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a UDP socket with the specified address family.

methods.name: BindToNetwork
methods.description: Binds the socket to a specific network handle.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects the socket to a remote address.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds the socket to a local address.

methods.name: ReadMultiplePackets
methods.description: Reads multiple packets from the socket.

methods.name: WriteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes datagram buffers to the socket.

methods.name: GetUnwrittenBuffers
methods.description: Returns buffers that have not yet been written.

methods.name: RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives data from the socket along with sender address.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specific address.

methods.name: SetDoNotFragment
methods.description: Sets the socket to not fragment packets.

methods.name: is_connected
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected or bound.

methods.name: SetMulticastTimeToLive
methods.description: Sets the TTL for multicast packets.

methods.name: SetWriteAsyncEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables write async mode.

methods.name: AdoptOpenedSocket
methods.description: Adopts an already opened socket descriptor.
